theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_bl_db_eventual_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (m h H o : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (θ₀ η₁ : ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < θ₀ → 0 < η₁ → K ≠ ∞ → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → m r ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ₀ * h r + K * o r) → ENNReal.ofReal η₁ ≤ liminf (fun r : ℝ => m r / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) → limsup (fun r : ℝ => H r / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ 1 → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => o r / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → ∃ r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < r₀ → ENNReal.ofReal (η₁ / (4 * θ₀)) * (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n)) ≤ h r ∧ H r ≤ 2 * (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))
